nc0aac908ac.headline: Béni Mansour - Bejaïa - Doubling of the railway track - Towards the start of works despite opposition
nc0aac908ac.summary: The Algerian authorities requested the start of works to double the Béni Mansour – Béjaïa railway track, moving forward despite some opposition.
nc0aac908ac.why: Rail infrastructure projects in Algeria are key to improving logistics, trade, and economic development in the region.
